title: Can You Scare the Hiccups Out of a Manhole?
titles: Can You Scare the Hiccups Out of a Manhole?
Why Is This Manhole Spitting Out My Stuff?
Why Did the Manhole Hiccup a Rubber Duck?
The Manhole Hiccuped, and Then I Got It Too
Can a Scare Cure a Hiccuping Manhole?
description:
A silent 3D mini-story: a man in a cobbled square faces a giant manhole cover that hiccups. Each hiccup spits out something new, a boot, then a rubber duck. He tries to scare the hiccups away, and the answer is not what he expects.
Fiction made with AI-assisted tools. Original 3D animation; nothing here is real footage or a real event.
Character animations: Mixamo.
